# The picker-button port still exercises the date input path

The owned port replaces only the non-mailbox date input shadow-button ID with picker-button. The mailbox branch keeps showPicker, and the shared helper waits for a date panel and checks a date value. The upstream title does not establish a tested time-input feature or paired engine behavior. Existing delays and other control checks remain separate.

Scope: Shared browser form-picker harness.
